$comment: WorkBuddy plugin manifest/registration facts from Phase 0 probe P01 (2026-10-12), real engine 2.161.0 / desktop 5.8.1, isolated config dir. These facts define how a PD WorkBuddy plugin must declare and register itself.

pluginLayout.hooksFile: hooks/hooks.json at plugin ROOT (NOT inside .codebuddy-plugin/); hooks field in plugin.json may also point to a custom path
envVarsInHookCommand: CODEBUDDY_PLUGIN_ROOT (absolute plugin dir; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT alias also set)
pluginLayout.frontmatterHooksGate: hooks/hooks.json is NOT subject to allowUntrustedFrontmatterHooks (that gate is only for Agent/Skill frontmatter hooks)

marketplaceInstall.marketplaceManifest: <marketplace-root>/.codebuddy-plugin/marketplace.json with {name, plugins:[{name, source:'./<plugin-dir-inside-marketplace>', ...}]} (root-level marketplace.json is NOT read; source outside marketplace root is rejected: 'Path escapes marketplace root')
marketplaceInstall.registryFile: <config>/plugins/installed_plugins.json (version 2) records scope:user, installPath (absolute, inside cache), version, installedAt
marketplaceInstall.cacheLayout: <config>/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/ (plugin copied from marketplace source; version from plugin.json)
marketplaceInstall.builtinMarketplaces: engine materializes official marketplace zips into any config dir on first run (cb_teams_marketplace, codebuddy-plugins-official observed)

sessionScopedDevLoad.writes: nothing to settings; plugin active for that process only; observed data-dir artifact <config>/plugins/data/<name>-inline

activationTime.installOrUpdate: takes effect in NEW sessions, or immediately via /reload-plugins (CLI prints this hint); no restart of other processes required
activationTime.uninstall: same rule; verified: after uninstall, new sessions fire NO plugin hooks; enabledPlugins entry removed (empty object retained); installed_plugins.json entry removed; cache directory orphaned in place (not deleted in probe)

hookDiscoveryForSessions.sourcesMerged: settings.json hooks key + installed/enabled plugin hooks/hooks.json + scoped (frontmatter/subagent) registry
hookDiscoveryForSessions.pluginHooksRequire: plugin installed AND enabledPlugins true (or --plugin-dir / defaultEnabled)

hooksSettingsKeyFormat.note: user-level hooks can also be declared directly in settings.json under "hooks" with the same EventName shape; probe verified plugin path; settings-path hooks were not separately matrix-tested
